dI0 - snehasya GRutAdeH pAnasya vidhirvidhAnaM, sa ca vidhiScarake yathA sapraSna uktastamAha - ?sAMKyaiH saMKyAtasaMKyeyaiH sahAsInaM punarvasum | jagaddhitArthaM papracCa vahniveSaH svasaMSayam || kiMyonayaH kati snehAH ke ca snehaguNAH pRuthak | kAlAnupAne kaH kasya katidhA ca vicAraNAH || kati mAtrAH kathaM mAnAH kA ca keShUpadiSyate | kaSca keByo hitaH snehaH prakarShaH snehane ca kaH || snehyAH ke ke ca na snehyAH, snigdhA~atisnigdhalakShaNam | kiM pAnAtprathamaM pIte jIrNe kiM ca hitAhitam || ke mRudukrUrakoShThAH kA vyApadaH siddhayaSca kAH | Sodhane Samane caiva snehe kA vRuttiriShyate || nareShu keShu vidhinA kena yojyA vicAraNAH | snehasyApyamitaj~jAna ! j~jAnamicCAmi veditum? (ca. sU. 13,1-6) iti | 'tatra saMKyAnamadhIyante vindate vA te sAMKyAH, taiH; kiMviSiShTaiH ? saMKyAtasaMKyeyaiH, saMKyAtA saMKyA yaiste saMKyAtasaMKyeyAH | j~jAtaj~jeyA ityarthaH | taiH saha AsInam, uta cAsaMKyAtasaMKyeyaM sahAsInaM punarvasum iti pAThaH. | etaduktaM Bavati - sAKyaiH sahAsInaM punarvasuM saMKyAvikArakAyAM kathAyAM vartamAnaM tatkAlAnurUpam agniveSo~api svasaMSayaM pRuShTavAn | dvikarmako~ayam | tatra ' kati snehAH ? etasyottaramAha -

vya_text: dI0 - sa snehaH catuHprakAraH, GRutAdiBedAt | tatra GRutaM gavyaM SreShThatvAt; tailaM tilasnehaH; vasA-'SuddhamAMsasya yaH snehaH sA vasA parikIrtitA iti | majjA iti majjA mastakamajjA asthimajjA vA | tathAca - 'sthUlA~asthiShu viSeSheNa majjA tvaByantarASritA | athetareShu sarveShu saraktaM meda ucyate’ iti | taduktaM carake - 'tilAH priyAlABiShukau biBItakaScitrABayairaNDamadhUkasarShapAH | kusumBabilvArukamUlakAtasI nikocakAkShoTakara~jjaSigrujAH || snehASayAH sthAvaraja~ggamAstathA syurja~ggamA matsyamRugAH sapakShiNaH | teShAM dadhi kShIraGRutAmiShaM vasA sneheShu majjA ca tathopadiSyate’ iti | aBayA harItakI, citrA dantI iti || ( ca. sU. 13,8)

dI0 - mAtrAlakShaNamagre vakShyamANam | doShAstrividhAScaturvidhA vA teShAM balam utkRuShTa-madhyA-lpAdiBedena j~jeyam | kAlAH SItoShNavarShAlakShaNAstrividhAH eShAM balaM hInamadhyAtimAtrasvarUpaM, BeShajagrahaNakAlaM vA | agnirapi sama-viShama-manda-tIkShNamedena caturvidhaH asya balaM pAcakApAcakarUpam | vayo~api bAla-madhyottaraBedena trividhaM tasyApi balaM svaSaktisAmarthyam | buddhimAniti sadvaidya iti SeShaH | tathAhi - 'yathAdoShaM yathAkAlaM yathAvyAdhiM yathAbalaM | snehapakvamapakvaM vA pAkaM yu~jjyAccikitsakaH' iti | doShAdInapekShya snehasya hInAdimAtrAM prayojayet, hInatarAmapi prayojayet | uktaMca - hInamadhyottamA mAtrA tAstAByaSca hRusIyasIm | kalpayedvIkShya doShAdIn prAgeva tu kanIyasIm || ( vA. sU 16|17) ‘aj~jAtakoShThe hi bahu kuryAjjIvitasaMSayam’ iti || 4 ||

 ' dvAByAM caturBiraShTABiryAmairjIryanti yAH kramAt | hasvamadhyottamA mAtrA ’ (vA. sU 16,17) iti | ahorAtreNa mahatI jIryatIti | nanvahorAtragrahaNaM sahRudayahRudayAhlAdakaraM na Bavati, kutaH ? ahani dvayornADikayoranantaraM pItasya snehasya pare~ahni GaTikAdvayAnantaraM pAkaH sacAhorAtragrahaNenaiva gRuhyate | ahorAtragrahaNam aShTau praharapramANakAlaparaM j~jeyam | evaM paramacatureNa vAgBaTenAShTau praharAdipramANamevoktaM tadvadatrApyahorAtramaShTau praharaparaM j~jeyam | evamuttaratrA~api vyAKyeyam | seti | sA alpA hrasvA suKAvahA j~jAtavyA | suKakAriNItyarthaH | SIGrapAkatvAt || 8 ||

dI0 - atha tAsAM viShayamAha - alpA mAtrA snehasya dIpanI Bavati agnidIptikarItyarthaH | vRuShyA SukravRuddhikarI, svalpadoSheShu hInabaleShu doSheShu vA pUjitA | kAraNe kAryopacArAt | svalpadoShe svalparogeShu vA iti svalpanidAnenAlpasaMcite | madhyamA catuHpraharairyA pAkaM prApnoti sA madhyamA | sA snehanI rUkShANAM | bRuMhaNI sarvadhAtUnAm | BramaScakrArUDhasyevArthasaMvittiH | vastudarSanam | jyeShTheti | jyeShThA uttamA kuShThAdihAriNI Bavati | carake tu hrasvAdimAtrANAM viShayaguNAScoktA yathA - 'ye tu vRuddhASca bAlASca sukumArAH suKocitAH | riktakoShThatvamahitaM yeShAM mandAgnayaSca ye || jvarAtIsAra- kAsASca yeShAM cirasamutthitAH | snehamAtrAM pibeyuste hrasvA ye cAvarA bale || parihAre suKA caiShA mAtrA snehanabRuMhaNI | vRuShyA balyA nirAbAdhA ciraM cApyanuvartate ||' (ca. sU. 13,36 - 38) atra vRuddhAdayaH kleSAsahiShNutvAt hrasvasnehamAtrArhAH | suKocitA iti na kumAraviSeShaNaM kiMtu pRuthageva suKasAtmyA aBimatAH |
 riktakoShThatvamahitamiti | vAtaprakRutivikArANAm ahitaM ye cAvarA bale alpabalA ityarthaH | parihArasuKeti vyAyAmamuccairvacanamityAdike parihAre sati suKamiyamAdhatte ato hrasvA~api mAtrA parihAre sati suKamAdadhyAt | tatra madhyamottamayornitarAM parihAraH kartavyaH | ityevaM 'yato’ nirdeSa iti kaScit | anyastu vyAcaShTe - parihAraviShaye suKeyamakriyamANApi parihAre na doShAvahetyarthaH | 'praBUtasnehasAtmyA ye kShutpipAsAsahA narAH | pAvakaScottamabalo yeShAM ye cottamA bale || gulminaH sarpadaShTASca visarpopahatASca ye | unmattAH kRucCramUtrASca gADhavarcasa eva ca || pibeyuruttamAM mAtrAM tasyAH pAne guNAn SRuNu | vikArAn SamayatyeShA SIGraM samyak prayojitA | doShAnukarShiNI mAtrA sarvamArgAnusAriNI | balyA punarnavakarI SarIrendriyacetasAm || ityuttamA | madhyamAmAha -aruShkasPoTapiTikAkaNDUpAmABirarditAH | kuShThinaSca pramIThASca vAtaSoNitikASca ye | nAtibahvASinaScaiva mRudukoShThAstathaiva ca | pibeyurmadhyamAM mAtrAM madhyamAScApi ye bale || mAtraiShA mandaviBraMSA na cAtibaladAyinI | suKena ca snehayati SodhanArthe ca yujyate ||’ iti (ca.sU 13|29-35) | arUMShyevArUMShyA | arUMShikA SirorogaviSeShaH | arditAH pIDitAH | pramIThA atyarthaM pramehapIDitAH | tasyA guNAnAha - mAtraiShA mandaviBraMSeti | mandA alpA viBraMSAH balahAnyAdayo yasyAM sA | yadA AturAdidoShABAvAt viBraMSo notpadyate tadA suKena snehayati | SodhanArthe yujyate ityanenaitatkathayati uttamA mAtrA SamanAya | tathAca carake -- 'vikArAn SamayatyeShA SIGraM samyak prayojitA’ iti | hrasvAt bRuMhaNArthA | uktaMca 'mAtrA snehanabRuMhaNI’ iti | (ca. sU. 13|38)| asyArthaH - snehanabRuMhaNakarmakAriNI iyaM BuvanakAmAnAM virecanakAmAnAM ca prayujyate | iti mAtrAvivaraNam || 9 || 10 ||

mahAgnimArutaprANA vasAyogyA narAH smRutAH || 14||

vya_text: gU0 - evaMBUtA narA vasAyogyA Bavanti iti yojyaM | kiMBUtAH ? vyAyAmakarShitAH, vyAyAmo mallAdiyuddhadhanurAkarShaNAdiH, tatkarShitAH | kShINAH, SuShkaM kShINaM reto vIryaM raktaM ca yeShAM te SuShkaretoraktAH | punaH mahArujaH vyathAvantaH | punaH kiMBUtAH ? mahAnagnirmAruto vAyuH prANAH balaM ca yeShAM te mahAgnimArutaprANAH || 14 ||

dI0 – majjAviShayamAha -- krUreti | krUrASayAH krUrakoShThAH, kleSasahAH GasmarAH, vAtArtAH vAtarogiNaH, dIptavahnayastIkShNAgnayaH | majjAyA alABe sarpiHprayogamAha - sarpirvA sarvato hitamiti | sarvataH sarvasnehaviShaye sarvavyAdhau ca, sarpirGRutaM hitaM pathyam | etacca majjAlABe j~jeyam || 15 ||

pada:
majjAyogyAnAha --
krUrASayAH kleSasahA vAtArtA dIptavahnayaH |
majjAnaM ca pibeyuste sarpirvA sarvato hitam || 15 ||

vya_text: gU0 - krUrASayAdinarA majjAnaM pibeyuH | krUra ASayaH koShTho yeShAM te krUrASayAH | punaH kleSasahAH duHKasahAH | punaH vAtArtAH | punaH dIptavahnayaH ||15||

dI0 - Atyayike vyAdhau snehasya kAlamAha -- SIteti | vAtapittAdhike iti | atra vAtasya yogavAhitvAt pittAdhikaSca gRuhyate | evaM vAtaSleShmAdhika ityatrApi vyAKyeyam | pittaSleShmAdhikastu nokto~apyatra sAdhAraNaH SIta eva kAle pibediti draShTavyam | rAtrAviti sAyam || 16 ||

pada:
snehapAnakAlaH |
SItakAle divA snehamuShNakAle pibenniSi |
vAtapittAdhike rAtrau vAtaSleShmAdhike divA ||1 6||

vya_text: gU0 - SItakAlAdau snehaH kadA peya ityAha -- SItakAle iti | sugamam || 16 ||

dI0 - doShaSabdo~atra SarIradUShaNAddoShAH vAtAdayaH, dhAtavo rasAdyAH,, malASca grAhyAH | teShAM balAbalaM dRuShTvA samyagvicArya tailaM GRutaM vA yatra tailasAtmyaM doShabalaM tatra tailameva yujyAt | yatra GRutasAtmyaM tatra GRutameveti tattatsAtmyAnAM tattadyu~jjIta || 17 ||

pada:
atha tailaGRutayorviSiShTakarma darSayannAha —
nasyABya~jjanagaNDUShamUrdhakarNAkShitarpaNaiH |
tailaM GRutaM vA yu~jjIta dRuShTvA doShabalAbalam || 17 ||

vya_text: gU0 - nasyAdau GRutaM tailaM vA yojyaM tadAha -- nasyeti | nasA peyaM nasyam, aBya~jjanaM mardanaM, gaNDUShaH kavalaH, mUrdhA mastakaM, karNaM Srotram, akShi netram | tattarpaNe ApyAyane GRutaM vA tailaM vA yojyam || 17 ||

dI0 - GRute iti | anu paScAt niyataM pAnam anupAnaM GRute koShNaM jalaM peyam | taile yUShamanupAnam | vasAmajj~joH maNDamanupAnam | kecinmaNDaSabdenAtra strotoviSodhanatvAt dadhimaNDamAhuH, tanna - yato BaktamaNDo~api mRudUkaroti srotAMsi | uktaMca - ‘maNDo vAtAnulomanaH, tRuDglAnimedodoShaGnaH, pAcano, dhAtusAmyakRut' iti | suKAvahamiti | suKam Avahati karoti tatsuKAvaham, samyak pAkAdikaraNAt | uktaMca vAgBaTe - ‘anupAnaM karotyUrjAM tRuptiM vyAptiM dRuDhA~ggatAm | annasaMGAtaSaithilyaviklRuptijaraNAni ca’ iti | anyacca - 'jIrNAjIrNaviSa~gkAyAM punaruShNodakaM pibet | tenodgAre viSuddhiH syAttataSca laGutA ruciH ||' ( vA. sU.16|23) iti | etaduShNodakaM sAmAnyena sarvasnehe~api hitam | uktaMca - 'uShNodakAnupAnaM ca snehAnAmatha Sasyate | Rute BallAtakasnehAttatra toyaM tu SItalam' iti || 18 ||

pada:
idAnIM snehAnAmanupAnAnyAha -
GRute koShNaM jalaM peyaM taile yUShaH praSasyate |
vasAmajj~joH pibenmaNDamanupAnaM suKAvaham || 18 ||

vya_text: gU0 - GRutapAnAdau anupAnamAha - GRute iti | GRute koShNaM jalaM peyam | taile yUShaH | vasAmajjAdiShu maNDaM BaktAdiBUtaM tadanupAnaM, anupAne suKAvaham || 18 ||

dI0 - sAnnasnehasya viShayamAha -
 sneheti | snehadviShaH snehArucayaH ‘uShNakAmAn’ ityatra ‘tRuShNAlukAn’ iti paThanti kecit | sahaBakteneti | BaktamodanaH cakAro~atra luptodayaH tena carakoktAScaturviMSatisnehavicAraNA grAhyAH, tA yathA - ‘odanaSca vilepI ca raso mAMsaM payo dadhi | yavAgUH sUpaSAke ca yUShaH kAmbalikaM KaDaH || SaktavastilapiShTaM ca madyaM lehAstathaiva ca | BakShyamaBya~jjanaM bastistathaivottarabastayaH || gaNDUShaH karNatailaM ca nasyaM mUrdhAkShitarpaNam | caturviMSatirityetAH snehasya pravicAraNAH ||' iti (ca. sU. 13|21-23) vAgBaToktAScatuHShaShTivicAraNAScAtraiva grAhyAH, tA yathA - ‘rasaBedaikakatvAByAM catuHShaShTirvicAraNA' iti | (vA. sU. 16| 15) nanu - 'acCapeyastu yaH sneho na tAmAhurvicAraNAm (ca. sU. 13|24) iti carakavacanAtkathaM catuHShaShTidhA iti virodhaH ? maivaM nAdyaH, peyo vicAraNA ityasyAyamarthaH - acCapeyasnehaH sA na vicAraNA, sAtmyartuvyAdhyAdiShu vicAraNAstyeva | uktaMca carake - 'rasaiScopahitaH snehaH samAsavyAsayogiBiH | ShaDBistriShaShTidhA saMKyA prApnotyekaSca kevalaH || evametAScatuHShaShTisnehAnAM pravicAraNAH | sAtmyartuvyAdhipuruShAnprayojyA jAnatA Bavet ’ iti | ( ca. sU.13|23-26) puruShagrahaNena deSasAtmyamavaruddhaM, yato deSamapekShya puruShasya tatsAtmyaM, tathA puruShagrahaNena prakRutibalavayaHSarIrapraBRutayo~avaruddhvA iti || 19 ||

pada:
sAnnasnehasya viShayamAha -
snehadviShaH SiSUnvRuddhAnsukumArAn kRuSAnapi |
udyAkAmAnuShNakAle saha Baktena pAyayet || 19 ||

vya_text: gU0 - yeShAM snehaM pAyayettAnAha - sneha iti | uShNakAle grIShmAdau etAn Baktena saha snehaM pAyayet | snehaM dviShantIti snehadviShaH tAn atiprItau SiSUn , bAlAn , vRuddhAn , sukumArAn , kRuSAdIn , tRuShNAturAMScApi| || 19 ||

dI0 - rUkShANAM sadyaH snehanayogadvayamAha - sarpiShmatIti | sarpiShmatI bahuGRutA | sadya iti tasminneva divase tvarayA snehanaM karoti | sadyograhaNaM stutiparamityanye tryaheNa snehayatItyarthaH | ata evoktaM sevyamAneneti | aparamapi - SarkarAcUrNasaMGRuShTe iti | dohanasthe dohanaBANDe sthite GRute | kiMBUte ? SarkarAcUrNasaMGRuShTe SarkarAmiSrite | tadBANDe gAM dugdhvA rUkShaH puruShaH taddugdhaM sadyaH svalpakAlena snehamucyate iti || 20 || 21 ||

pada:
idAnIM snehaM vinApi yavAgvA snehanamAha -
sarpiShmatI bahutilA yavAgUH svalpataNDulA |
suKoShNA sevyamAnA tu sadyaH snehanakAriNI ||20||
SarkarAcUrNasaMGRuShTe dohanasthe GRute tu gAm |
dugdhvA kShIraM ShibeduShNaM sadyaH snehanamucyate || 21 ||

vya_text:
gU 0 - idAnIM snehaM vinApi yavAgvA snehanamAha -
sarpiShmatIti | evaMBUtA yavAgUH sadyaH snehanakAriNI Bavati | kiMBUtA ? sarpiShmatI, punaH bahutilA svalpataNDulA, punaH suKoShNA | kShIramapi sadyaH snehanaM Bavati | tadAha SarkarAcUrNasaMBRuShTe Barjite dohanasthe gAM dugdhvA kShIramuShNaM pibet sadyaH snehanaM Bavati || 20 || 21 ||

dI0 - atha snehAjIrNe cikitsAmAha —
mithyeti | mithyAcaraNAduShNodakAdInAm | amithyAcArastu vAgBaTenoktaH -'uShNodakopacArI syAdbrahmacArI kShapASayaH | na vegarodhavyAyAmakrodhaSokahimAtapAn|| pravAtayAnayAnAdhvaBAShyAByAsanasaMsthitIH | nIcAtyuccopadhAnAhaH svapnadhUmarajAMsi ca || yAnyahAni pibettAni tAvantyanyAnyapi tyajet | iti | (vA. sU. 16|25-27) bahutvAtsamAnAdhikyAdvA | athavA viShTaBya viShTamBaM kRutvA jIryati tamapi vAmayedityarthaH | asyAgre kecitpaThanti - 'tataH snehaM punardadyAt laGukoShThAya dehinaH | ayaM pATho bahuShu pustakeShu na dRuSyate vaidyasaMpradAye tu - 'tataH snehaM punardadyAt’ iti dinAntare jAtabale deyamiti || 22 ||

pada:
atha snehAjIrNe cikitsAmAha —
mithyAcArAdbahutvAdvA yasya sneho na jIryati |
viShTaBya vApi jIryeta vAriNoShNena vAmayet ||22||

vya_text: gU0 - mithyAcArAderyasya sneho na jIryati tatpratIkAramAha - mithyeti | mithyAcArAnmithyAcaraNAt, bahutvAtsnehAdhikyAdvA yasya sneho na jIryati viShTaBya viShTamBaM kRutvA vA jIryati tam uShNavAriNA vAmayet || 22 ||

dI0 - sneheti | ‘snehasyAjIrNaSa~gkAyAmapi uShNodakaM pibet kimuta jIrNe ityanena sarvAsvapyavasthAsu uShNodakamanupAne praSastamityaBiprAyaH | PalamAha - teneti | tena uShNodakena udgAraSuddhiH ruciSca BaktaMprati jAyate, Bojane rucirjAyate ityapi | tantrAntare tu - 'syuH pacyamAne tRuTdAhaBramasAdAruciklamAH | pariShicyAdBiruShNABirjIrNe snehe tato naram ’ iti || 23 ||

pada:
snehAjIrNe anyadapi pratIkAramAha --
srehasyAjIrNaSa~gkAyAM pibeduShNodakaM naraH | 
tenodgAre BavecCuddho BaktaM prati rucistathA || 23 ||

vya_text: gU0 - sneheti | sugamam || 23 ||

dI0 - sneheneti | paittikasya pittaprakRuteH puruShasya tIkShNatarIkRuta iti atyarthaM tIkShNatvaM prAptaH | tadA tasmin kAle asya puruShasya tRuShNAM viShamAM kaThinAm udIrayet utpAdayet tadA vAmayet uShNAmbu pItvA snehamiti SeShaH | uktaMca - 'snehapItasya cettRuShNA pibeduShNodakaM naraH | evaM cAnupaSAmyantyAM snehamuShNAmbunA vamet (suSru. ci. 31/24) iti | uddharet vAmayedityarthaH | ' ca ’ SabdaH prakArAntare | SItaM jalaM pAyayet tena hetunA pipAsA SAmyati || 24 ||

pada:
snehopadravaBUtAyAstRuShNAyAScikitsAmAha -
snehena paittikasyAgniryadA tIkShNatarIkRutaH |
tadAsyodIrayettRuShNAM viShamAM tasya vAmayet || 24 ||
 SItaM jalaM pAyayecca pipAsA tena SAmyati |

vya_text: gU0 - snehe pittaprakopAt pratIkAramAha - sreheneti | paittikasya pittapradhAnapuMsaH || 24 ||

dI0 - ajIrNIti | ajIrNI snehaM varjayet na pibet | tathA jIrNajvarI AmajvarI | durbalo balahInaH | arocakI arocakArtaH | sthUlo meduraH | madapIDitaH madAtyayI | dattabastiH yasya bastikarma kRutam | viriktaH kRutavirekaH kRutavAntiSca | tRuShNAyuktaH SramayuktaSca | akAlaprasavA nArIti | garBapAtasrAvAByAM yuktA strI | ShoDaSavarShAdarvAgapi prasavo~akAlaprasava ityeke | durdinaM meGacCanne~ahni durdinam | cakArAdvAgBaToktAH - ‘snehyA natvatimandAgnitIkShNAgnisthUladurbalAH | UrustamBAtisArAmagalarogagarodaraiH || mUrcCACardyaruciSleShmatRuShNAmadyaiSca pIDitAH | apaprasUtA yukte ca nasye bastau virecane’ iti ( vA. sU. 16|6, 7) || 25 || 26 ||

pada:
atha snehA~ayogyAnAha -
ajIrNI varjayetsnehamudarI taruNajvarI || 25 ||
durbalo~arocakI sthUlo mUrcCArto madapIDitaH |
dattabastirviraktaSca vAntastRuShNASramAnvitaH || 26 ||
akAlaprasravA nArI durdine ca vivarjayet |

vya_text: gU0 - yeShAM snehapAnaM niShiddhaM tAnAha - ajIrNIti | ajIrNI ajIrNavAn snehaM varjayet, tathA udarI udararogavAn taruNajvarI arocakarogayuktaH | durdinaM ’meGacCanne~ahni durdinam |’ spaShTamanyat || 25 || || 26 ||

dI0 - snehyAnAha - svedyeti | svedyAdInAM snehanam uttamam | ete snehArhAH, svedyAH svedArhAH, saMSodhyA vamanavirecanArhAH | madyAdiShu AsaktaM mAnasaM cittaM yeShAM te tathA | tathA kShINAsrAH kShINaraktAH, kShINaretasaH kShINaSukrAH, vAtArtA iti vAtenArtAH pIDitAH, timirArtAH taimirikAH iti || 27 || 28 ||

pada:
yeShAM snehapAnaM praSastaM tAnAha -
svedyasaMSodhyamadyastrIvyAyAmAsaktamAnasAH || 27 || 
vRuddhA bAlAH kRuSA rUkShAH kShINAsrAH kShINaretasaH | 
vAtArtAstimirArtA ye teShAM snehanamuttamam || 28 ||

vya_text: gU0 - svedyeti | evaMBUtA ye teShAM snehapAnam uttamam | kiMBUtAH ? svedyAH svedanArhAH, SodhyA vamanAdiSodhanocitAH | madyastrIvyAyAmasaktAH anuraktAH cintakAstu cintanaparASca | kShINAsrAH kShINaraktAH kShINavIryAH || 27 || 28 ||

dI0 - vAtAnulomyamiti | samyaksnigdhe etAni lakShaNAni Bavanti | vAtAnulomyaM vAtasya anulomatA, agnirjaTharAgnirdIptaH | varcaH purIShaM snigdhaM cikkaNam asaMhataM SithilaM mRudusnigdhA~ggatA ca Bavati | glAnirojaHkShayaH snehodvegaH snehapAne dveShaH, lAGavaM SarIralaGutA | vimalendriyateti - cakShurAdIndriyANAM vimalatvaM svasvaviShayagrahaNasAmarthyam | etairlakShaNaiH samyaksnigdho j~jeyaH || 29 ||

pada:
samyak snigdhasya lakShaNamAha -
vAtAnulomyaM dIpto~agnirvarcaH snigdhamasaMhatam |
mRudusnigdhA~ggatA glAniH snehodvego~atha lAGavam ||29|| 
vimalendriyatA samyak snigdhe

vya_text: gU0 - snehe pIte samyaksnigdhalakShaNamAha - vAtAnulomyamiti | samyaksnigdhe vAtAnulomyAdilakShaNaM Bavati | vAtAnulomyaM vAtasya samyakpravRuttiH, agnirdIptaH, varcaH purIShaM, snigdhaH sacikkaNam, asaMhatam amilitam | mRudva~ggatA komalA~ggatA, snigdhA~ggatA sacikkaNA~ggatA, aglAniH aklamaH, snehAvegaH snehopadravABAvaH | lAGavaM dehasya, vimalendriyatA nirmalendriyatA || 29 ||

dI0 - rUkShe viparyayaSca Bavati | sa cAsnigdhalakShaNasya | uktaMca carake - 'purIShaM grathitaM rUkShaM vAyurapraguNo mRuduH | paktA KaratvaM raukShyaM ca gAtrasyAsnigdhalakShaNam’ iti | (ca. sU. 13|55) vAyuratra guNaH mRuduH paktA agnimAndyam | anyatrApyuktaM - 'rUkShaM purIShaM grathitaM pakvAnnaM na vipacyate | uro vidahyate vAyuH koShThAdupari dhAvati || nirbalo durbalaScApi rUkSho Bavati mAnavaH’ iti ||

pada:
rUkShe lakShaNamAha –
---- rUkShe viparyayaH |

vya_text: gU0 - rUkShe tu etadviparyayaH ||

dI0 - BaktadveSha iti | BRuSasnigdhasyAtisnigdhasya BaktadveShAdilakShaNam | tatra BaktadveSho BojanAnAkA~gkShA | muKasrAvaH hRullAsaH, gude dAhaH | 'gude pAkaH’ iti pAThaH | pravAhikA atIsAraBedaH | tandrA prAg vyAKyAtA | atIsaraNamatIsAraH | pANDutvaM SarIrasya | carake tu - pANDutA gauravaM jADyaM purIShasyAvipakvatA | atyutkleSo~arucistandrI syAdatisnigdhalakShaNam’ iti | (ca. sU. 13|57) sadanaM a~ggAnAM jADyaM jaDIBAvaH kAyasya, purIShasyAvipAkatA~asamatA, atyutkleSo hRullAsaH, nidrArtasya viShayAgrahaNaM tandrIti || 30 ||

pada:
atisnigdhalakShaNamAha --
BaktadveSho muKasrAvo gude dAhaH pravAhikA ||30|| 
tandrAtIsArapANDutvaM BRuSaM snigdhasya lakShaNam |

vya_text: gU0 - atisnigdhapAne lakShaNamAha - Bakteti | BRuSaM snigdhasya atisnehapItasya, idaM BaktadveShAdilakShaNaM BavatIti yojyam | Bakte dveShaH BaktAruciH, muKasrAvaH muKasyAsamantAt srAvaH lAlAsravaNaM, gude dAhaH | pravAhikA atIsAraBedaH, tandrA IShanmudritanetratvam, atIsaraNaM, pANDutvaM pItavarNatA || 30 ||

dI0 – athahInAtisnigdhasyopakramamAha -
 rUkShasyeti | rUkShasya puruShasya snehaiH sadyaHsnehanakAriBistailaGRutAdiBiH snehanaM kAryaM, atisnigdhasya rUkShaNaM kAryam || 31 ||

pada:
athahInAtisnigdhasyopakramamAha - 
rUkShasya snehanaM snehairatisnigdhasya rUkShaNam || 31 ||

vya_text: gU0 - rUkShasya snigdharUkShaNamiti | pratIkAramAha - rUkShasya snehanaiH snehanam | atisnigdhasya rUkShaNai rUkShaNam || 31 ||

dI0 – rUkShayogamAha -
 SyAmAketi | SyAmAkAdiBI rUkShaNaM kAryam | AdigrahaNAt vAgBaToktaM sarvaM grAhyam | yathA – ‘kShuttRuShNolleKanasvedarUkShapAnAnnaBeShajam | takrAriShTaKaloddAlayavaSyAmAkakodravam || pippalI triPalA kShaudraM pathyA gomUtragugguluH | yathAsvaM pratirogaM ca snehavyApadi sAdhanam’ iti || kecit 'SyAmAkacaNakAdyaiH’ ityatra ‘SyAmAkakoradUShAnnaiH' iti paThanti | piNyAkaM niHsnehatilakalkam ||

pada:
rUkShayogamAha -
SyAmAkacaNakAdyaiSca takrapiNyAkasaktuBiH |

vya_text: gU0 – kaiH ? takrapiNyAkAdyaiH snehanam | SyAmAkacaNakAdyai rUkShai rUkShaNam | SyAmAkaH dhAnyaviSeShaH | (sAva) piNyAkastilakalkaH ||

dI0 - atha snehasevino lakShaNamAha -
 dIpteti | snehasevI naraH dIptAgniH syAt | agniratra jaTharAgniH | SuddhakoShTha iti madhyakoShThakrUrakoShThAdirahitaH | puShTadhAtuH rasAdipuShTadhAtuH | dRuDhendriyaH cakShurAdIndriyabalayuktaH' | nirjaraH, balavarNADhyaH, varNADhyaSca, surUpaSca | vAgBaTe tu – ’dIptAntarAgniH pariSuddhakoShThaH pratyagradhAturbalavarNayuktaH | dRuDhendriyo mandajaraH SatAyuH snehopasevI puruShaH pradiShTaH iti (vA. sU. 16|46) || 32 ||

pada:
atha snehasevino lakShaNamAha -
dIptAgniH SuddhakoShThaSca puShTadhAturdRuDhendriyaH || 32 || 
nirjaro balavarNADhyaH snehasevI BavennaraH |

vya_text: gU0 - snehasevI yAdRuSo Bavati tAdRuSamAha - dIpteti | nirjaraH jarArahitaH | balavarNayuktaH | spaShTamanyat || 32 ||

dI0 - snehasevAyAM varjyAnyAha -
 snehe snehapAne | vyAyAmaM SarIrAyAsajananakarma | saMSItamiti atyarthaSItavAtAdikaM | vegAGAtamiti vegAnAM mUtrapurIShotsargecCAnAm AGAtam avarodhaM vegadhAraNamityarthaH | prajAgaramiti rAtrijAgaraNam | aBiShyandi SleShmaprakopi dadhyAdikamityarthaH | rUkShAnnamiti SyAmAkacaNakAdikam | etacca sAmAnyasnehapAnaviShaye yatra ca atisnigdhatA Bavati tatra rUkShAnnaM vihitameva | tatpUrvameva || 33 ||
iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe snehapAnAdhyAyaH prathamaH || 1 ||

pada:
snehasevAyAM varjyAnyAha -
snehe vyAyAmasaMSItavegAGAtaprajAgarAn || 33 ||divAsvapnamaBiShyandi rUkShAnnaM ca vivarjayet | divAsvapnamaBiShyandi rUkShAnnaM ca vivarjayet |
iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadharAcAryeNa praNItAyAM SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAmuttaraKaNDe snehavidhirnAma
prathamo~adhyAyaH || 1 ||

vya_text:
gU0 - snehapAne yanniShiddhaM tadAha - snehe iti | snehe snehapAne, vyAyAmAdIn vivarjayet | saMSItam atiSItalaM, vegAGAtaM vAtamUtrapurIShAdirodham | divAsvapnamaBiShyandivirodhi | rUkShAScANakAdi | spaShTamanyat || 33 ||
iti SrIkASirAmavaidyaviracitAyAM gUDhArthadIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe pa~jcakarmaNi snehapAnaM prathamo~adhyAyaH || 1 ||
